extracted.intended_audience: general educated readers; readers of 19th-century travel and natural history literature; historians of science/colonial studies
extracted.subtask_description: An excerpt from Charles Darwin's Voyage of the Beagle — a 19th‑century travelogue combining natural history, ethnographic observation, and landscape description of New Zealand and Australia. The text documents observations, comparisons, and reflections rather than prescribing evaluative criteria.
